test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: 

First and second letter → (2) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

Second and third letter → (4) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

​​So, checking the options one by one :

Option - (1) : GIM 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02cc727de1fd19f2a3d0ba9885f4e620d61cd6f9bb6113b4f5fec13d45b5d4c4.png] 

Option - (2) : PRV 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db619939a25371a9ee196b30bd614aabae72507e7cc576209ad8cfe865d8f9bb.png] 

Option - (3) : HJN 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f701e2ce115f1caf887f8da25a4070d228ea00efbad998d3e26719f94f89f0bd.png] 

Option - (4) : EGJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cddc470ae1ffb2d10e7deeb778ceb0f6fa7e10ac8879a0405b48620f267bc2f0.png] 

Thus, out of all options "EGJ" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
